info.description: API for GopherSocial, a social network for gophers

get.description: Returns every badge definition (earned + assigned). Admin only.

post.description: Registers a new admin-assigned badge definition. Admin only.

delete.description: Removes an admin-assigned badge definition not currently held by any user. Admin only.

patch.description: Edits an admin-assigned badge definition. Earned badges are immutable. Admin only.

post.description: Awards an admin-assigned badge to a user. Admin only.
post.summary: Grant a badge to a user

delete.description: Removes an admin-assigned badge from a user. Admin only.
delete.summary: Revoke a badge from a user
